summary.text: Brenda Carter is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives representing District 53 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Brenda Carter's general-election opponent is Melissa Schultz (R).
She has worked as a grant writer and a fiscal consultant and is Minority Vice Chair of the Insurance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Brenda Carter lives in Pontiac, Michigan, graduated from Detroit Northern High School, and earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from Spring Arbor College in 1996 and a master's degree in public administration from Oakland University in 2014.
Her career experience includes working as a grant writer and a fiscal consultant.
She has been affiliated with the Council of Urban Boards of Education, the National School Board Association, and the Oakland County School Board Association.

Carter assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2023; in 2023-2024 she chaired the Financial Services Committee, and in 2025-2026 she is Minority Vice Chair of the Insurance Committee and a member of the Health Policy Committee.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she listed her priorities as affordable healthcare and fair insurance, good-paying jobs and skilled trades, affordable and safe housing, and investment in communities.
